modules.name: Core Public API
modules.summary: Published ESM barrel and event types for the dependency-injected agent engine; frozen by public-api.test.ts.

modules.name: Agent Engine
modules.summary: Agent state machine, streaming loop with sequential tool calls, host-neutral context-manager checkpoint, compaction planning, steering queues with one atomic accept/receipt path (steering_accepted), and idle watchdog.

modules.name: LLM Abstraction
modules.summary: Provider-neutral message/stream types, the retry authority, output-token ceilings with learned cache and recovery, model registry, and the shared incremental SSE parser.

modules.name: LLM Providers
modules.summary: Anthropic, OpenAI-compatible, and Google adapters plus the ProviderRegistry that dispatches and retry-wraps them.

modules.name: Core Tool System
modules.summary: Typed tool definitions, registry, Ajv-or-fallback validation, and guarded execution with timeout, abort, progress, and truncation.

modules.name: Core Skills Runtime
modules.summary: Pure skill parsing, validation, ranking, progressive disclosure, invocation, and turn-scoped tool policy.

modules.name: CodeAct Sandbox
modules.summary: Optional isolated-vm JavaScript execution with console, HTTP, and tool bridges; never re-exported from the root barrel.

modules.name: CLI Composition and Boot
modules.summary: Commander composition root (cli.tsx), the published launcher bin, and the crash-recovery boot guard below main().

modules.name: Agent Host Runtime
modules.summary: AgentController bridging config/services into Core, headless print mode, the view reducer with receipt-driven queued entries, queued-message reconciliation, model-profile settings transactions, system prompt assembly, mode cycling, usage accounting, and the typed TUI task boundary.

modules.name: Context Auto-Compaction
modules.summary: Default-on compaction policy: ContextMeter occupancy, pressure triggers, safe cuts, bounded summarization ladder, tail relief, archives, child managers, and /compact + /context commands.

modules.name: Fast Model Tier
modules.summary: Second cheaper model tier: resolution authority, periodic lead-run review with a bounded frame ring, and the conditionally spliced prompt block.

modules.name: Team Subagents
modules.summary: Batch child-agent delegation through one task tool call: dispatch runtime, budgets, mailboxes, human queue, reports, and roster projection.

modules.name: TODO Planning
modules.summary: todo_write full-list replacement, pure store, rail windowing, follow-through policy, and the <todo_planning> prompt block.

modules.name: Background Service Supervision
modules.summary: ProcSupervisor owning every spawned child: service classification, platform tree kill, readiness racing, bounded log rings, and the <background_services> prompt block.

modules.name: Host Tools
modules.summary: Builtin tool factory (fs/search/bash), paste-independent proc tools (bash_output/bash_kill), plan tools, structured patches, and the side channels that carry UI data without spending model tokens.

modules.name: Slash Commands
modules.summary: Command registry and the 29 builtin commands (including /queue) plus /perf and the /skills family; /reset and /resume cancel unreceived queued messages.

modules.name: Configuration and State
modules.summary: Validated config loading, schema/defaults/clamps with deep-merge writes, the self-versioned modelProfiles library with transactional store and role resolution, 45 ARAGON_* env overrides, home migrations, prompt history, and UI state.

modules.name: Machine-Facing Exec
modules.summary: aragon exec surface: options/permission resolution, schema-v1 events, text/JSON/NDJSON emitters, the runner mapping activity to events, budgets, signals, and progress reporting.

modules.name: Session Persistence
modules.summary: Managed JSON conversation sessions: id/path validation, safe resume ids, per-cwd pointers, locks, pruning, and list/show/rm CLI.

modules.name: CLI Skill Lifecycle
modules.summary: SkillHost implementation: discovery, trust, archives, source fetch, staged installs, updates, cross-process locks, manifests, usage counting, and tools/commands.

modules.name: Self-Update
modules.summary: Registry check, semver authority, install-source eligibility ladder, detached installer, cross-process lock, state, and event stream.

modules.name: Boot Guard
modules.summary: Crash recovery below main(): failed-start counting, health marking, and rollback reinstall with dynamic-only imports.

modules.name: Structured Logging
modules.summary: Scoped JSONL logging, buffered sinks with retention, secret redaction registry, process hooks, and log CLI commands.

modules.name: Diagnostics
modules.summary: aragon info capability metadata and doctor health checks with remedies and exit codes.

modules.name: Terminal Input
modules.summary: The stream Ink is given: mouse report stripping, paste framing and recognition, pointer routing, keymap, interrupt gesture, and structural bounds.

modules.name: Terminal UI
modules.summary: Ink application shell surfaces: App, composer with paste tokens, Enter frames, editor navigation and explicit-copy coordination, queue panel/status row, model-profile overlays, transcript, render caches/governor, frame differ/parser/observer, scrollbar controller, theme, and capabilities.

modules.name: Transcript Entries
modules.summary: Per-kind transcript renderers: assistant/user/tool cards, diffs, team, todo, fast, retry, compaction, and service cards.

modules.name: Layout Mathematics
modules.summary: Pure geometry and allocation: frame budget, virtual window, scroll, follow-state, scrollbar geometry, rail/document/team/todo/autocomplete layout.

modules.name: Release Tooling
modules.summary: Brand assertions, release preflight, published-artifact verification, and their Node/PowerShell tests.

modules.name: Design Plans
modules.summary: Feature specifications and manual-test matrices covering every shipped subsystem.

components.summary: Profile library domain module: types plus pure validation/normalization - 200-entry cap, unique ids, dangling mainId/fastId reference detection, create/duplicate/remove.

components.name: commitModelSettings
components.summary: Profile disk transaction layer: sha256 revision conflict detection, one atomic write, legacy connection-patch adaptation, secret registration.

components.name: projectModelProfiles
components.summary: Profile resolution module: projects bound main/fast profiles onto an effective config copy, detects session overrides, and resolves the one key scoped to the role and target.

components.name: registerQueueCommand
components.summary: Registers /queue, the command that opens the scrollable full-text queue overlay.

components.name: splitEnterSequences
components.summary: Enter-sequence module (with ENTER_SEQUENCES and rewriteEnterSequences): pure modified-Enter byte table with longest-prefix holding for torn stdin chunks.

components.name: splitEnterFrames
components.summary: Enter-frame decoding: turns one input chunk into ordered composer intents (text, paste, newline, submit); paste and Enter frames sharing a chunk keep byte order.

components.name: planComposerInput
components.summary: Pure planner applying composer intents (text/paste/newline/submit) before any submission side effect; rejected drafts and extra submissions stay visible.

components.name: buildEditorVisualMap
components.summary: Editor navigation module (with moveVisualCursor): grapheme-accurate cursor math and the hard-wrapped visual cell map for the multiline draft.

components.name: createClipboardCoordinator
components.summary: App-owned Ctrl+C copy coordinator: synchronous busy claim, one in-flight task, cleanup tracking, abort on dispose.

components.name: buildActionClauses
components.summary: Width-budgeted bottom hint-row planner; drops the lowest-priority clauses while the Esc clause is always reserved. Strings come from interaction-copy.ts.

components.name: QueuePanel
components.summary: Persistent queue footer panel; renders the precomputed QueueLayout with no timers or own state.

components.name: QueueStatusRow
components.summary: One-row status-bar queue feedback: earliest pending summary, grapheme-safe truncation, (+N more), paused variant.

components.name: QueueOverlay
components.summary: Scrollable full-text queue overlay with (queueId, offset)-anchored scrolling across re-wraps and an explicit empty state.

components.name: ModelProfilePicker
components.summary: Profile picker/manager overlay: search, per-entry key status, Main/Fast users, duplicate-to-diverge, current-custom row.

components.name: ModelProfileEditor
components.summary: One-profile form overlay: provider/model/base URL/credential modes; key input registers secrets; validates before merging into the draft.

components.name: modelProfileReducer
components.summary: The profile screen state machine (picker/manager/editor/confirmations); every edit touches only the draft, persistence belongs to Save.

components.name: QueuedEntry
components.summary: One-row transcript card for a message queued mid-run (Queue: first line +N lines); rewritten in place, same id, into a user entry by its receipt.

components.name: planStatusFields
components.summary: One-row status-bar field planner with phase-queue-context budgeting, label degradation, and long-label upgrades.

components.name: validateSession
components.summary: Hand-rolled recursive validation of untrusted session files (roles, content parts, per-kind entry shapes, unique entry and queue ids) before resume mutates anything.
